retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, painterly tropical landscape featuring heavy impasto brushstrokes and a hand-lettered script in the upper right corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A lush, textured landscape painting characterized by bold, visible brushstrokes and a saturated palette of reds, greens, and yellows, depicting a tropical scene with a central figure and organic hand-lettered typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Large red mountain backdrop contrasting with green foreground foliage
Central vertical tree trunk anchoring the mid-ground
Small human figure in the lower left providing scale
White script typography positioned in the upper right negative space
coreInvariants: Visible impasto texture throughout the entire canvas
High-saturation color palette dominated by cadmium red and sap green
Organic, non-geometric forms for all natural elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A small figure in the bottom left foreground; large overlapping trees in the center; a massive mountain filling the upper two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark green central tree mass.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the figure in the bottom left, follows the path upward through the trees to the mountain, and ends at the typography in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the canvas is densely packed with color and texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow and white (sunlight and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with medium value; shadows are rendered through color shifts rather than black.

letterConstructionRules: Variable line weight suggesting a round brush
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are soft and looped
Uppercase letters are integrated into the flow of the lowercase
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script style to maintain the organic, handmade feel of the painting.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the painterly medium of the background.
Reflects the era of the original artwork.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a post-impressionist oil painting of a tropical landscape with a red mountain, green trees, and a small figure on a path, using heavy impasto brushstrokes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered white script in the upper right corner, ensuring the strokes look like they were painted with a round brush over the texture.

verificationChecks: Is the texture visibly thick and painterly?
Is the red mountain the dominant background element?
Is the text hand-lettered and white?
Is the figure in the bottom left small and integrated into the scene?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no digital artifacts are visible in the brushstrokes.
Verify the text is legible but retains a 'painted' quality.
Check that the red and green balance doesn't feel vibrating or harsh.
Confirm the canvas texture is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a Gauguin-style tropical landscape with heavy impasto application and top-right aligned organic script.
